checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Eyes, nose, mouth, jaw and proportions look the same, including the mole on the cheek.
Skin looks natural with visible texture and no obvious de-aging, though slightly crisper and a bit more polished.
The curls keep the same shape and length, and the subtle closed-mouth smile is preserved.
A navy blazer over a dark top replaces the grey knit.

must.item: Park replaced with unobtrusive backdrop and flattering lighting
must.why: A plain grey backdrop with soft, even light on the face.

faults.what: The backdrop is a fairly flat mid-grey with a slight gradient, and the dark top blends with the blazer, so the outfit has little contrast.
Skin tone is slightly warmer and more polished than the source, with a subtle retouched look.

summary: The output is a convincing professional headshot that keeps the face, skin texture, curls and expression recognisably the same, with a navy blazer, grey backdrop and soft lighting, and only minor polish differences.
